title: Embrace – Embrace health care
text: Scroll to top How can we help? Ask me anything about our services… Medium Term Accom Medium Term Accommodation (MTA) offers temporary funding for housing during transition, such as awaiting home modifications. It’s for those with a future home but needing a place until arrangements are finalised. This support, lasting up to 90 days, covers accommodation costs, but participants must handle their food and daily expenses. Care services are billed separately, ensuring support during important transitional periods without using the NDIS plan for living costs. Our MTA offers Furnished Living Spaces Our accommodations are usually fully furnished, providing all necessary amenities for a comfortable stay. This includes kitchen facilities, allowing guests to prepare their own meals and enjoy a homely atmosphere. Cost-Efficiency Our medium-term accommodation often comes at more affordable nightly rates than short-term stays, offering a cost-effective solution that blends the affordability of long-term leases with the flexibility of short-term rentals.
